test.doc: Verifies the framework tries all strategies in priority order. For chkPriority (no AutomationId), it should fall back from: FlaUI:AutomationId -> FlaUI:Name -> WPFSpy:Name -> Sikuli:Image

suite.doc:
Layer 1 — Demonstrates multi-driver fallback. PriorityCheckbox is a non-standard control that requires WPFSpy (via Name) for interaction since it has no AutomationId.
The framework now supports multiple strategies per driver: - FlaUI: AutomationId -> Name -> Type+Index - WPFSpy: XPath (AutomationId) -> XPath (Name) -> Type+Index - Sikuli: Image-based fallback
